column1: August 24, 2018 - Scott Morrison emerges victorious in a three way leadership ballot and becomes Prime Minister
September 15, 2015 - Malcolm Turnbull challenges and defeats Tony Abbott to become Prime Minister
October 13, 2013 - Bill Shorten is elected as the new leader of the ALP over Anthony Albanese
September 7, 2013 - Tony Abbott leads the L-NP (53.5%) cf. ALP (46.5%) to Federal Election victory
